title: CompletionEvent v1
description: The message a worker sends to the completion queue (lai_processing.contracts.events.CompletionEvent). Exactly one of result (inline) and result_ref (the canonical result JSON stored as a report.job_result artifact of the same attempt) is set. The event is not trusted on its own: Django accepts it only when job, attempt, idempotency key, namespace and input checksum match its record (core/lifecycle.py decide_completion). The Python decoder is authoritative and also checks that the envelope mirrors the inline result and that result_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the result's canonical JSON.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event (lowercase UUID). A redelivered message keeps it.

emitted_at.description: When the worker emitted the event (UTC, Z suffix).

retry_class.description: The inline result's retry_class (null for a success). For a by-reference event the encoder writes null; the consumer reads the retry class from the fetched result.

result_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the result's canonical JSON; the consumer checks the result it reads against it.

result.description: The result inline, when the encoded event fits the message limit; otherwise null.

result_ref.description: Reference to the stored result (artifact_type report.job_result, same job and attempt, sha256 equal to result_sha256) when the result is not inline; otherwise null.
